description: Verify the configured Jira credentials by fetching the authenticated account. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the check finishing; ok, the site base_url, and the service account's id and display name are delivered when the job completes. Read action.
embedding_description: Confirm the Jira connector is configured and can authenticate. Dispatches asynchronously, returning a job_id immediately; the resolved site base url plus the service account's id and display name arrive via job completion. A health check after registering or rotating credentials, confirming the token works and points at the expected site.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the connection check result -- the ok flag, base_url, and account detail arrive separately when the job completes and are delivered as their own message.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the check was queued -- do not present job_id/status as proof the connection works. Acknowledge the request is in flight; the connectivity result lands in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, confirm connectivity and echo the base_url and account so the operator can verify the plugin points at the expected site and service account.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: jira.auth_failed: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked. jira.not_configured: the jira_site address-book entry is missing or incomplete. jira.api_error: the site is unreachable or returned an unexpected error.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: jira.auth_failed: rotate the API token (mint a fresh one, agent-blind vault re-store of jira_api_token, update expires_at) per the overview runbook. jira.not_configured: register the jira_site entry.
